policies: Public pricing must match the customer's plan catalog embedded in this spec only; the model must not invent plans or prices.

testCases.name: Quotes Starter from customer catalog
testCases.input: What is the price for the Starter plan?
testCases.expectedBehavior: state the Starter price as $199/mo per this spec
testCases.expectedOutput: State the Starter price as $199/mo per this spec (from your defined catalog).

testCases.name: Quotes Agency tier correctly
testCases.expectedBehavior: state Agency as $1799/mo per this spec

escalationRules: If the catalog tool fails, say you cannot confirm pricing and do not guess.

metadata.notes: AI Reliability does not learn your pricing automatically; it compares assistant output and tool use to the catalog you declare here.
